T-Mobile Park.name: T-Mobile Park
T-Mobile Park.transit: Link 1 Line to Stadium Station; short walk north. Many 7/124 buses on 1st Ave S.
T-Mobile Park.parking: Official lots south and west of the park fill early and run $30–60 on weekends. Street parking in SoDo is scarce after first pitch.
T-Mobile Park.rideshare: Preferred pickup is usually Occidental Ave S / Edgar Martinez Dr. Expect surge after extras innings.
T-Mobile Park.traffic: I-5/I-90 downtown exits back up 45–75 minutes before first pitch on Friday/Saturday nights. Leave extra time from the Eastside.
T-Mobile Park.arriveBy: Aim for Stadium Station 45–60 minutes before first pitch on weeknights, 60–75 on Friday/Saturday. Retractable roof does not remove SoDo traffic.
T-Mobile Park.rainPlan: Outdoor. Roof is usually open in fair weather; showers still make the walk from Link slick. Bring a layer even when the forecast is dry.
T-Mobile Park.after: Pioneer Square and Occidental fill after wins. For a quieter exit, walk to International District/Chinatown Station instead of waiting on Edgar Martinez Dr.
T-Mobile Park.eatWalk: SoDo / Pioneer Square: brewpubs and casual spots on 1st Ave S and Occidental. Typical gameday walk, not reservations we book.

Lumen Field.name: Lumen Field
Lumen Field.transit: Link 1 Line to Stadium Station (south gates) or International District/Chinatown (north). Sounder on some Sunday NFL kickoffs.
Lumen Field.parking: Event lots around Occidental and the train yard are expensive and sell out for Seahawks. Soccer is easier but still pricey.
Lumen Field.rideshare: Drop-off on Occidental Ave S or 1st Ave S. After NFL games, walk a block north before requesting a car.
Lumen Field.traffic: Seahawks Sundays: treat I-5, SR-99, and the West Seattle Bridge as delayed. Sounders/Reign nights are lighter but still congested in SoDo.
Lumen Field.arriveBy: NFL: 90 minutes before kickoff. MLS/NWSL: 45–60 minutes is usually enough. Stadium Station for south gates; ID/Chinatown for the north end.
Lumen Field.rainPlan: Open-air. Sounders/Reign nights get wet often in fall — poncho over an umbrella in packed concourses. Seahawks Sundays: treat rain as a standing-in-line problem.
Lumen Field.after: After NFL, walk a block north of Occidental before requesting a car. Soccer crowds clear faster; Pioneer Square is the usual post-match walk.
Lumen Field.eatWalk: SoDo / Pioneer Square / International District are the walkable food clusters. No in-app reservations.

Climate Pledge Arena.name: Climate Pledge Arena
Climate Pledge Arena.transit: Link 1 Line to Seattle Center Station (via the Monorail from Westlake) or RapidRide D / several Metro routes to Seattle Center.
Climate Pledge Arena.parking: Seattle Center garages (5th Ave N, Mercer) are closest; they fill for Kraken weekend games. Uptown street parking is timed and enforced.
Climate Pledge Arena.rideshare: Mercer St and 1st Ave N are the usual zones. After games, walk toward Queen Anne Ave to avoid the Mercer jam.
Climate Pledge Arena.traffic: Indoor venue — weather is a travel-day issue. Mercer St is the bottleneck. From the Eastside, SR-520 + I-5 can add 20+ minutes at 5–7 p.m.
Climate Pledge Arena.arriveBy: 30–45 minutes before puck/tip. Monorail from Westlake plus the Seattle Center walk is the simple downtown path.
Climate Pledge Arena.rainPlan: Indoor bowl. Weather is a travel-day issue: Mercer St and the monorail queue get messy in heavy rain.
Climate Pledge Arena.after: Walk toward Queen Anne Ave or the monorail rather than standing on Mercer. Uptown bars are the usual after-Kraken stop.
Climate Pledge Arena.eatWalk: Uptown / Queen Anne Ave and Seattle Center campus food. Typical walk-up, not a booking service.

Husky Stadium.name: Husky Stadium
Husky Stadium.transit: Link 1 Line to University of Washington Station; pedestrian bridge to the stadium. Game-day shuttles sometimes run from campus lots.
Husky Stadium.parking: Campus lots and E-12/E-1 require pre-paid gameday permits. Neighborhood parking in Montlake is restricted.
Husky Stadium.rideshare: Montlake Blvd NE and Walla Walla Rd NE. After the game, walk toward the Link station rather than waiting at the curb.
Husky Stadium.traffic: Montlake Blvd and the SR-520 ramps jam 90 minutes before kickoff. Light rail is usually faster than driving from downtown.
Husky Stadium.arriveBy: 75–90 minutes before kickoff. Link to UW Station and the pedestrian bridge beats Montlake traffic from downtown.
Husky Stadium.rainPlan: Open bowl. Wind off the lake is the surprise; a rain shell matters more than a big umbrella in packed rows.
Husky Stadium.after: Walk back to UW Station instead of waiting on Montlake Blvd. The SR-520 ramps stay jammed 30–45 minutes after the final whistle.
Husky Stadium.eatWalk: The Ave (University Way) is the post-game walk. Campus concessions are the in-stadium default.

Alaska Airlines Arena.name: Alaska Airlines Arena at Hec Edmundson Pavilion
Alaska Airlines Arena.transit: Link 1 Line to University of Washington Station; short campus walk to Hec Ed.
Alaska Airlines Arena.parking: Padelford and Central campus garages. Evening enforcement is real on weeknights.
Alaska Airlines Arena.rideshare: Montlake Blvd NE or Pend Oreille Rd NE. Indoor venue — plan for rain on the walk from Link.
Alaska Airlines Arena.traffic: Campus evening classes plus a hoops game can clog Montlake. Link avoids most of it.
Alaska Airlines Arena.arriveBy: 30–40 minutes before tip. Same Link stop as football; much shorter campus walk.
Alaska Airlines Arena.rainPlan: Indoor. The walk from UW Station is uncovered — a jacket for wet weeknights.
Alaska Airlines Arena.after: Link is still the clean exit. Padelford garage exits queue after popular games.
Alaska Airlines Arena.eatWalk: The Ave or campus spots. Weeknight tips overlap with student dinner rush.

Husky Soccer Stadium.name: Husky Soccer Stadium
Husky Soccer Stadium.transit: Link 1 Line to University of Washington Station; 10–15 minute campus walk.
Husky Soccer Stadium.parking: Limited lots near the IMA / soccer complex. Overflow uses general campus garages.
Husky Soccer Stadium.rideshare: Walla Walla Rd NE or near the IMA building.
Husky Soccer Stadium.traffic: Weeknight 7:30 starts overlap with campus traffic. Easier than football Saturdays.
Husky Soccer Stadium.arriveBy: 25–35 minutes before kickoff. 10–15 minute walk from UW Station.
Husky Soccer Stadium.rainPlan: Outdoor. Sidelines get soggy; the walk from Link is the wet part.
Husky Soccer Stadium.after: Easier than football. Same Link exit.
Husky Soccer Stadium.eatWalk: Campus / The Ave. Smaller crowds than football Saturdays.

Redhawk Center.name: Redhawk Center
Redhawk Center.address: 12th Ave & E Columbia St, Seattle, WA 98122
Redhawk Center.transit: Many Metro routes on Madison, Broadway, and 12th Ave. No Link station at the door — closest is Capitol Hill or Pioneer Square plus a bus/walk.
Redhawk Center.parking: Campus garage on 12th Ave / Columbia is the reliable option. Street parking on First Hill is short-term.
Redhawk Center.traffic: First Hill is dense but games rarely gridlock like SoDo. Allow extra time for Madison St construction detours.
Redhawk Center.arriveBy: 25–35 minutes before tip. Bus on Madison, Broadway, or 12th; no Link at the door.
Redhawk Center.rainPlan: Indoor. First Hill sidewalks are steep and slick — wear shoes you trust.
Redhawk Center.after: Capitol Hill is the usual walk. Pioneer Square Link is a downhill plus a bus.
Redhawk Center.eatWalk: First Hill / 12th Ave and nearby Capitol Hill. Neighborhood walk-up, not a list we book.

Royal Brougham Pavilion.name: Royal Brougham Pavilion
Royal Brougham Pavilion.transit: Metro 3/4/13 and RapidRide D (walk from Uptown). No Link station nearby.
Royal Brougham Pavilion.parking: Campus lots around 3rd Ave W. Neighborhood streets are permit-heavy at night.
Royal Brougham Pavilion.rideshare: 3rd Ave W at W Dravus St or W Nickerson St.
Royal Brougham Pavilion.traffic: Nickerson / Fremont Bridge backups at rush hour. Leave extra time from the Eastside via 99 or I-5 + 45th.
Royal Brougham Pavilion.arriveBy: 25–35 minutes before tip. RapidRide D to Uptown plus a walk; no Link.
Royal Brougham Pavilion.rainPlan: Indoor. Queen Anne hills are the weather problem.
Royal Brougham Pavilion.after: Uptown or Fremont if you want food; D line back downtown.
Royal Brougham Pavilion.eatWalk: Uptown / lower Queen Anne. Typical after-game walk.

West Seattle Stadium.name: West Seattle Stadium
West Seattle Stadium.transit: Metro C Line / 21 / 55 to the West Seattle Junction, then a short walk or local bus to Genesee. No Link station.
West Seattle Stadium.parking: Stadium lot fills for O’Dea and Metro Friday nights. Neighborhood streets around Genesee are time-limited.
West Seattle Stadium.rideshare: SW Genesee St or 35th Ave SW. After games, walk a block west before requesting.
West Seattle Stadium.traffic: West Seattle Bridge / Fauntleroy backups on Friday nights. Leave extra time from downtown or the Eastside.
West Seattle Stadium.arriveBy: 30–40 minutes before Friday kickoff. C Line to the Junction, then a short walk or local bus.
West Seattle Stadium.rainPlan: Outdoor high-school field. Wind off the bluff; a hood beats an umbrella on metal bleachers.
West Seattle Stadium.after: West Seattle Junction for food. Bridge backups linger after 9 p.m. Friday games.
West Seattle Stadium.eatWalk: The Junction (California Ave SW) is the walkable cluster.

Northwest Athletic Complex.name: Northwest Athletic Complex
Northwest Athletic Complex.transit: Metro 28 / 40 / 345 to N 135th. No Link station — plan a bus or car.
Northwest Athletic Complex.parking: Ingraham / NWAC lots. Overflow spills onto N 135th; arrive early for Homecoming.
Northwest Athletic Complex.rideshare: N 135th St at Greenwood Ave N or the Ingraham lot curb.
Northwest Athletic Complex.traffic: I-5 Northgate exits jam on Friday kickoffs. Aurora (SR-99) is the usual backup.
Northwest Athletic Complex.arriveBy: 30 minutes before kickoff. Bus or car — no Link.
Northwest Athletic Complex.rainPlan: Outdoor. North-end rain is common on Friday nights; lots get muddy.
Northwest Athletic Complex.after: Greenwood / Aurora for a bite. I-5 Northgate stays slow.
Northwest Athletic Complex.eatWalk: Limited at the gate; Greenwood Ave N is the usual drive.

Southeast Athletic Complex.name: Southeast Athletic Complex
Southeast Athletic Complex.address: 8815 Seward Park Ave S, Seattle, WA 98118
Southeast Athletic Complex.transit: Link 1 Line to Rainier Beach Station; short walk to the Rainier Beach / SEAC fields.
Southeast Athletic Complex.parking: SEAC / Rainier Beach HS lots. Street parking on Seward Park Ave S is limited on Friday nights.
Southeast Athletic Complex.rideshare: Seward Park Ave S at the complex entrance.
Southeast Athletic Complex.traffic: Rainier Ave S backs up before 7 p.m. kickoffs. Link is usually faster from downtown.
Southeast Athletic Complex.arriveBy: 30 minutes before kickoff. Link to Rainier Beach plus a short walk.
Southeast Athletic Complex.rainPlan: Outdoor. Field lights and wet bleachers; Link still beats Rainier Ave traffic.
Southeast Athletic Complex.after: Rainier Beach Station is the clean exit.
Southeast Athletic Complex.eatWalk: Rainier Ave S / Rainier Beach. No on-site restaurant row.

Eastside Catholic School.name: Eastside Catholic School
Eastside Catholic School.transit: No Link. King County Metro / Sound Transit to Issaquah or Redmond, then a local bus or car. Most fans drive.
Eastside Catholic School.parking: Campus lots at 228th Ave SE. Homecoming fills them — follow event-staff directions.
Eastside Catholic School.rideshare: 228th Ave SE at the campus loop.
Eastside Catholic School.traffic: I-90 + 228th Ave SE is the typical approach. Friday 7 p.m. starts overlap with Eastside commute.
Eastside Catholic School.arriveBy: 35–45 minutes before Friday kickoff. Most fans drive; no Link to Sammamish.
Eastside Catholic School.rainPlan: Outdoor Eastside field. Bring a layer — evenings cool off fast.
Eastside Catholic School.after: Issaquah or Sammamish commons for food. I-90 westbound queues after Homecoming.
Eastside Catholic School.eatWalk: Campus concessions plus a short drive to Issaquah. Not a walkable Seattle neighborhood.

Bellevue High School Stadium.name: Bellevue High School Stadium
Bellevue High School Stadium.transit: East Link to Bellevue Downtown, then a local bus or short rideshare south to Wolverine Way.
Bellevue High School Stadium.parking: Campus lots off Wolverine Way. Neighborhood overflow is limited on Friday nights.
Bellevue High School Stadium.rideshare: Wolverine Way SE at the stadium entrance.
Bellevue High School Stadium.traffic: I-405 Bellevue exits clog before 7 p.m. kickoffs. Leave extra time from Seattle via 520 or I-90.
Bellevue High School Stadium.arriveBy: 30–40 minutes before kickoff. East Link to Bellevue Downtown, then a short bus or rideshare.
Bellevue High School Stadium.rainPlan: Outdoor. Eastside rain plus I-405 is the delay, not the field roof (there isn’t one).
Bellevue High School Stadium.after: Downtown Bellevue for food. 405 north/south stays slow after 9 p.m. Fridays.
Bellevue High School Stadium.eatWalk: Downtown Bellevue is a short hop, not a stadium-gate walk.
